items.prompt: What should accompany a latency/error alert before it is actionable?
items.modelAnswer: Service/revision, user-impact population, window/units/denominators, threshold/severity/minimum/no-data policy, owner/runbook and safe diagnostic links; test routing/reset/telemetry gaps. Unknown timeouts/censoring and sampling/cardinality/privacy limits remain. A pure summary/rule is not a deployed monitor or root-cause proof.
